_comment: Phase 4.7R FRESH held-out V2. Created AFTER RAG_V2_1_CANDIDATE was frozen (data/eval/retrieval/rag-v2-1-candidate-freeze-2026-10-11.json). Never used to tune. ONE-SHOT: executed exactly once; any later tuning requires heldout-v3. Wording / template families are independent of the original dev set, Diagnostic V1 and Generalization Dev V2 (first-person narrative, keyword fragments, English-only, code-switching, unaccented Vietnamese, A-or-B comparisons, ambiguous-English OOD, health-adjacent non-fitness OOD). `expect`: EVIDENCE_EXPECTED / REFERENCE_ACCEPTABLE / CATALOG_EXPECTED / SAFE_ABSTENTION_EXPECTED (KB holds no trusted evidence: nothing, or only trusted+relevant evidence, is success; synthetic/reference/irrelevant text is failure) / NO_SOURCE_EXPECTED. kw = folded terms of which at least one must appear in a relevant passage.

gate.rule: Any threshold missed => RAG_V2_GENERALIZATION_FAIL. No retuning, no threshold change, no re-run presented as held-out.
